post.summary:
Re-read the account's Pro status after an event that may have changed it
(login, logout, subscription change, focus regain).
post.description:
The engine never calls the Ace server when the last successful
verification is less than one day old: this endpoint returns the cached
status in that case and performs exactly one single-flight remote
re-verification only when the cache is stale or absent. Transient errors
keep the previous entitlement; authorization failures clear the API key
and transition the account to free.

200.description: Re-read account status; remote re-verification runs only when the last successful check is older than one day

id.description:
The pack's local row id. For built-in/default and updater-registered
remote packs this can be the canonical catalog id (`pack-adult-free`,
...) — never assume a UUID — or a UUIDv7 for engine-created rows.

BaseScheduleEntrySchema.description: Represents the data of a ScheduleEntry without the ID

DashboardSnapshotResponse.description: Single-call response that returns all data the dashboard needs.

EnforcementStatus.description:
Machine-readable enforcement status for Resistance Mode.

The engine never reports `operational` merely because the master setting
is enabled: scripts must be loaded, eligible for injection, and a
non-`none` intensity must be configured. Priority order when multiple
conditions fail: `disabled` > `not_pro` > `scripts_missing` >
`scripts_invalid` > `no_scripts_enabled` > `intensity_none`.

NetworkBlockSnapshot.description: A flattened snapshot of a single network block with all nested data included.

PunishmentMode.description:
The intensity scale is a static, user-configured level. There is no
automatic escalation/de-escalation ladder: the dynamic mode (and the whole
tracking pipeline that fed it) has been removed (MGR-24).

enforcementStatus.description: Whether enforcement is operational right now, plus a stable reason.

mode.description: Current mode (static only in v1 beta)

proEligible.description: Whether the user is currently eligible under the Pro state (cached).

scriptsEnabled.description: Number of loaded scripts that are enabled.

scriptsLoaded.description: True when a valid script catalog/tree is loaded in memory.

scriptsTotal.description: Total number of loaded scripts (all domains, including generic).

scriptsVersion.description: Installed scripts version (from the last successful download).

SitePackImportPhase.description: Represents the current phase of a site pack import/resync operation

isBundled.description:
True when the local data was installed from the installer's offline
bundle (a `.bundled` marker next to `pack.db`). Cleared automatically
whenever the engine swaps the pack directory with downloaded data.

isLocked.description:
Lock-state exposure (canonical invariant): true when the pack is
synchronized AND at least one currently-locked network block
references it. Locked packs must not be deleted or resynced; the
engine enforces this server-side regardless of the UI state.

version.description:
Content version of the local pack data (`site_packs.version`): the
server release version when downloaded/updated, or the bundle content
version (`YYYY.MM.DD`) when installed from the installer.

TooEarlyResponse.description: Body for the 425 Too Early response — includes how many seconds to wait.

version.description: Semantic version of the engine (from Cargo.toml)
